insight: Founded in SF in 2021 around a 'digital legacy' mission — preserving your learnings for future generations.
name: Glasp
tagline: Highlight, summarise, and chat with anything you read on the web.
description: Web-highlighter + AI extension. Save passages from any page, then ask AI for summaries, related ideas, or chat across your knowledge base. BYO key keeps your reading history private.
edge: Pairs a social highlight network with multi-format capture (web, PDF, YouTube) and BYO-key AI summaries.
pros: Highlights web pages, PDFs, and YouTube
cons: Private notes require paid Pro tier
